songs.lyrics:
[intro]
Dashboard stars and a salt-white moon
The tape rolls low on an old love tune

[verse]
Midnight leaning on the windshield glass
Blacktop shining as the headlands pass
Windows down and the ocean breathing
Every mile gives me one more reason
To leave the city and its borrowed names
Its shuttered rooms and its small blue flames
Your old jacket rides beside me
Like a quiet ghost that came to guide me
No fixed address, no finish line
Just the coastal curves and the dashboard time

[pre-chorus]
The rearview holds what I used to know
But the horizon says there is room to go

[chorus]
On the neon mile, I am coming alive
With the tape deck turning and the tide outside
Every green light opens like a door
I do not need to be afraid anymore
On the neon mile, where the dark runs wild
I can see tomorrow like a fearless child
All that I lost is fading behind
And everything ahead is mine

[verse]
Gas station halo at half past two
A paper cup and a sky washed blue
Somewhere dawn is already forming
Soft as a promise without a warning
I trace the map with a steady hand
No destination, just open land
The speakers hiss, then the chorus rises
Past sleeping towns and roadside signs
I keep moving with the white lines flowing
Maybe freedom is simply not knowing

[bridge]
If morning finds me far from home
I will meet it where the seabirds roam
No more waiting for a perfect sign
The road is enough, and the wheel is mine

[instrumental]

[outro]
Daybreak spills across the water
Gold on every mile behind
The tape clicks off, the coast keeps calling
And everything ahead is mine

songs.lyrics:
[intro]
Morning leans against the glass, buses coughing down the block
He is posted by the freezer with a sermon and a clock

[verse]
Corner store prophet in a weather-beaten coat
Got advice for every swimmer, never owned himself a boat
Tells the cook to leave his woman, tells the woman chase her dream
Tells the owner what is wrong with every losing baseball team
Says the mayor needs some backbone, says the landlord needs a heart
Then he asks to borrow twenty till his master plan can start
He can read your whole condition from the sneakers on your feet
While his rent is three months missing and his dinner is a seat

[pre-chorus]
Everybody gets a blessing, everybody gets a warning
He has solved your life completely by eleven in the morning

[chorus]
Corner store prophet, preaching underneath the sign
He can straighten out your future, just do not ask about mine
Got a kingdom made of milk crates, got a congregation passing
Giving gold to everybody while his pockets whistle laughing

[verse]
Kids come by, he tells them, Listen, keep your name out of the smoke
Old men nod like every hard year taught them how to take a joke
When the sirens split the evening, he grows quiet for a while
Then he helps Miss Rosa lift her groceries with a tired smile
Maybe wisdom is a jacket passed around against the cold
Maybe truth sounds even truer when the teller owns no gold

[bridge]
He says, Son, the world keeps charging for the things it never taught us
Then he waves away my question like the answer nearly caught us

[outro]
Night locks up the bodega, neon leaves his shadow thin
No rent for the room behind him, still the whole block lets him in
Corner store prophet, last word floating through the dark
You do not need a roof, he whispers, just one place to leave a mark

songs.lyrics:
[intro]
Blue light blinking on the bedroom wall
Lip gloss lightning, hear the city call

[verse]
Keys in my pocket, stars in my shoes
Mirror says tonight there is nothing to lose
Taxi lights are painting gold on the rain
My pulse keeps skipping when you say my name
Friends in the hallway counting down from ten
We do not know where, we just know when

[pre-chorus]
That electric hour is opening wide
Every door is glowing on the other side
Take my hand before the moment moves

[chorus]
We got sugar static under our skin
Sweet little shock where the night begins
Radio hearts and a reckless spark
Laughing like matches into the dark
Anything can happen, anything might
We are all voltage, dressed up in light
Sugar static, pull me into the blue
The whole wild city is waiting for you

[verse]
Street signs shimmer like a secret code
Bass from a window shakes the avenue gold
Someone spills perfume, somebody spins
Every passing stranger feels like where life begins
No destination, no alibi
Just silver clouds and a violet sky
We catch our reflections in a midnight train
Already different when we leave it again

[bridge]
Maybe we fall into somebody's story
Maybe we dance till the sunrise finds us
Maybe this hour is all of the glory
Still I want every bright second between us

[chorus]
We got sugar static under our skin
Sweet little shock where the night begins
Radio hearts with the windows down
Chasing that flash through the sleepless town
Anything can happen, anything might
We are all voltage, dressed up in light
Sugar static, carry us through
The whole wild city is coming into view

[instrumental]

[outro]
When morning asks us where we have been
We will smile, still sparkling
Sugar static fading slow
What comes next, nobody knows

songs.lyrics:
[intro]
Snow keeps the names no living mouth remembers
Blue fire trembles beneath the buried gate

[verse]
I crossed the moat where silver reeds stood brittle
Past marble wolves with winter in their eyes
The banquet hall was laid for vanished victors
Their cups held dust, their banners held the ice
Seven thrones leaned inward toward the darkness
Seven swords were rusting in the floor
Each king had sworn his blood would last forever
The kingdom stayed, and asked for nothing more

[pre-chorus]
No bell remained to mourn them
No hand remained to pray
Only the patient mountains
Watching crowns decay

[chorus]
Ashen crown, cold upon an empty chair
Who will wear you when the world has disappeared?
Stone outlives the promise, frost outlives the flame
A realm without a ruler still remembers every name
Ashen crown, keeper of the silent years
You have conquered every conqueror who brought you here

[verse]
I found a child’s small carving by the window
A wooden bird with one unfinished wing
Beyond the glass, the frozen roads ran nowhere
No hoof, no wheel, no herald for a king
The chapel doors had opened to the snowfall
White drifts slept softly where the faithful knelt
And in the crypt, beneath a cracked inscription
Iron crowns lay twisted where they fell

[bridge]
Perhaps the walls were never ours to master
Perhaps the land was dreaming us away
We called our borrowed seasons an empire
Then fed our golden centuries to gray

[instrumental]

[outro]
Dawn touches every tower without warming
The northern sky turns pale above the stone
I leave the crown untouched beneath its ashes
The kingdom keeps its vigil, all alone

songs.lyrics:
[intro]
Two o'clock rain on the window glass
Last call shining in a bottle half past

[verse]
We played the fast ones when the room was full
Now the chairs sit upside down and beautiful
Four tired strangers in a crooked line
One holds her coat, one nurses cheap red wine
One old man keeps time against his knee
One kid watches like he still believes
And Joe behind the bar wipes circles clean
Under the loneliest light I've ever seen

[pre-chorus]
So I lean into the microphone
Like it might carry somebody home

[chorus]
For the four in the room and the man pouring rye
For the ones who stayed when the good times said goodbye
We will play this last song like the whole world came
While the street runs silver in the two o'clock rain
No curtain call, no flowers, no name
Just five hearts listening to the two o'clock rain

[verse]
The drummer lays his brushes soft and low
The bass walks somewhere only lost souls go
My six-string hums like a midnight train
Then finds one blue note and lets it remain
The woman in the coat begins to sway
Joe stops his wiping, looks our way
Nobody speaks when the final chord bends
Maybe a small crowd makes the truest friends

[bridge]
We came for applause, for a room set aflame
But silence can love you without knowing your name
And every empty table, every unpaid mile
Disappears when four people stay awhile

[chorus]
For the four in the room and the man pouring rye
For the ones who stayed when the good times said goodbye
We played that last song like the whole world came
While the street ran silver in the two o'clock rain

[instrumental]

[outro]
Joe turned the sign and the night went still
We packed up slowly by the windowsill
Five quiet witnesses, one fading refrain
Then we walked out together in the two o'clock rain
